issue.title: Refresh stale chezmoi home memory instruction shims
issue.description: Discovered while verifying the approved wait-resolution fix with just check-full on 2026-08-09. The gate passed fmt, keep-sorted, Ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, patch/stitch terminology, Symvision, and toobig, then failed SASE validation at init memory --check. Output says it would overwrite five chezmoi-managed home instruction files/provider shims: ~/.local/share/chezmoi/home/AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, and OPENCODE.md, each +2 -2. I did not run sase init memory because memory/provider shim regeneration requires explicit owner permission in the current conversation. Scope: with owner approval, run the memory initialization from the canonical clean source so the chezmoi home shims are refreshed, then verify sase validate / just check no longer fails this gate. This is not the closed bob-cli-specific task sase-f8 and not the completed snoozed-status edit sase-gr; those only mention similar drift as context.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction while landing unrelated epic sase-i3 on 2026-08-09. After just install and focused glossary checks, just check passed fmt, keep-sorted, Ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, patch/stitch terminology, Symvision, and toobig, then failed SASE validation only at init memory --check. PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" sase memory init --check --diff reports the same five chezmoi home instruction files/provider shims, each +2 -2, changing headings from numbered subsection titles to unnumbered titles. No memory files were regenerated because this drift is unrelated to the glossary work and requires owner-approved memory init.

Independent reproduction while verifying sase-i5 (snooze test clock staleness) on 2026-08-09 in workspace 14. On a clean tree with no file changes of my own, 'just check' passed fmt/keep-sorted/ruff/mypy/pyscripts/test-waits/changelog/patch-terminology/symvision/toobig, then failed SASE validation at 'init memory --check': .venv/bin/sase validate reports the same 5 chezmoi-managed provider shims (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, OPENCODE.md) each need a +2/-2 overwrite. Unrelated to the snooze fix I was verifying.

Proposed by phase sase-i1.4.3 while adopting core 0.21.3: just check-full passed all repo gates through toobig, then init memory --check reported the same five chezmoi-managed instruction shims (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, OPENCODE.md) at +2/-2. This was independent of regex-search work and the phase correctly did not regenerate user memory without permission. Current land-agent rerun of sase validate is green, so the drift has since been resolved; this corroborates the historical duplicate rather than creating new work.

payload.close_reason: I think this is already fixed.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction on 2026-08-10 while verifying the unrelated dev_update/prebuild.py module split. After just install and 48 focused tests, just check passed fmt, keep-sorted, Ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, patch/stitch terminology, Symvision, and toobig, then failed only at SASE validation: init memory --check says ~/.local/share/chezmoi/home/sase/memory/README.md needs regeneration (+2/-3).
